decision.rationale: The independently sourced, deterministic confirmation package and blinded panel workflow are reproducible and ready for a separately bound review checkpoint without reopening the method design.
limitations: No LLM reviewer has evaluated the 200 confirmation cases, so no semantic-quality result exists.
The reference is deterministic source-derived silver evidence, not independent human ground truth.
The current Codex task has seen the controls and cannot act as the blinded Codex reviewer; a fresh isolated task is required.
No product method, professor-fidelity condition, deployment, or release is selected by this build.
